verdict.rationale: The evidence shows skills are installed as editable files in your repo, and that updates are pulled only when you run `npx skills update` or the plugin updates itself. That is update control, not a documented capability to version, review, or roll back automations. Versioning them through git would be a user-side workaround on host tooling. The 'review a diff' skill reviews code against a spec, not the automations themselves, so it belongs to a different story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
